test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a straight row facing North. P is sitting to the immediate right of S. S is sitting between T and P. Q is sitting at the extreme left of the row. R is sitting to the immediate right of Q. Who is sitting between Q and T?
solution: The sitting arrangement as per the given information: 1. Q is sitting at the extreme left of the row. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cd934588ffe5abba639a4d8698bc7e21c9680c740ad6973be8641edc0740d2e.png] 2. R is sitting to the immediate right of Q.
